verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same layout. In both, the three flavour chips are scattered on different rows and at different x-positions: Blood Orange sits low on the left, while Cucumber Mint and Honey Rosemary are stacked on the right. None of them line up with the text's left edge at x≈75. The Shop Flavours CTA floats off-axis to the right, and the bottom ~20% of the canvas is dead space apart from a cropped peach circle. B only moves the CTA and chip group down a few pixels, which gives the subhead slightly more room but fixes none of the alignment or grouping problems.
